name: The Traitor's Letters
about: The old spymaster dies, and in his chest are letters in a great lord's hand to the King's enemies: raiders' gold, a promise to open the gates, a share of the realm when the King falls. That lord is now buying other houses into the plot. Find the rest of the letters, break the league before it marches, or watch the houses choose his side.
title: The Traitor's Letters

beats.speaker: named
beats.text: The crown's old spymaster dies in his sleep. In his chest is one letter, in a great lord's hand, promising the King's enemies the gates of a royal town. The rest of the bundle is gone.

court.text: {named} of {named.house}, a little too carefully: "They say the old man found letters, Your Grace. Whose hand were they in?"

options.label: Search every lord's baggage for the rest (200 gold)
options.hint: the search begins · every lord gets nervous
options.result: The King's men search every chamber and saddlebag in Kingsmere. The great lords leave early.

options.label: Tell {named} the crown has them all, and smile
options.hint: {named.houseName} −10 · whoever is in the plot holds back, for now
options.result: The King says every letter is in his hands. {named} goes very pale, and very polite.

options.label: Burn the letter: a dead man's suspicion
options.hint: nothing now · the traitor keeps writing
options.result: The King drops the letter in the fire. Somewhere, its writer is writing another.

beats.speaker: thief
beats.text: {thief} is building a league. The foe's gold pays for it, and {named} is the next lord {thief.he} has bought: {named.house} sends {thief} silver and spears, and won't say why.

court.text: {named}, alone and quiet: "{thief} writes to your enemies, Your Grace, and {thief.he} has my name in those letters too. Break {thief.him} before the foe comes, and I'm yours."

options.label: Send the King's men to search {hall}
options.hint: {thief.houseName} −30 · if the letters aren't there, you look like a tyrant
options.result: The King's men tear {hall} apart by torchlight.

options.label: Set {named.house} on {thief.house}
options.hint: {named.houseName} +15 · {thief.houseName} −30 · {named.house} marches before the league is ready
options.result: The King gives {named} leave, and the letters to read out at {hall}'s gate. {named.house}'s host is on the road within the week.

options.label: Buy the letters from {thief}'s clerk (500 gold)
options.hint: {thief.houseName} +10, who doesn't know yet · the crown holds the proof
options.result: The letters change hands in a sept at midnight. {thief}'s clerk is on a ship by morning.

options.label: Wait for {thief} to show {thief.his} hand
options.hint: nothing now · more houses join the league
options.result: The King waits. Every week {thief} has more friends, and the foe's gold buys more.

beats.speaker: thief
beats.text: {thief}'s league is ready, and the foe's gold has paid for its spears. {thief} calls the great lords to {hall}, and enough of them come. Together they march on a King who never saw it coming.

beats.speaker: named
beats.text: The crown holds {thief}'s letters now, every one, with {thief.his} seal and the names of the houses {thief.he} bought. Every lord named in them is suddenly very loyal, and very afraid.

court.text: {named}: "The letters are yours, Your Grace. Read them out, and you'll have to fight half the names in them. Keep them, and every one of those houses is yours to command."

options.label: Read {thief}'s name alone, and burn the rest
options.hint: {named.houseName} +15 · {thief.houseName} −10 · the bought houses owe you their necks
options.result: The King reads one name aloud in the great hall and burns the rest unread. The lords breathe again, and know who spared them.

options.label: Keep them all, and call the named houses to the muster
options.hint: the named houses send their spears · every one holds a grudge
options.result: The letters go into the King's own chest. Every house named in them sends men to the next muster, and nobody asks why.

beats.speaker: named
beats.text: {thief}'s league is broken, and the King's enemies have lost their friend inside the realm. The houses that took the foe's gold remember how close they came.
